Initial release of Make Video — Create and Export Finished Videos.

- Instantly create polished videos by uploading footage and describing desired edits; no editing skills needed.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM uploads up to 500MB.
- Automated video processing: trim, add background music, export as shareable MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- No client install required; video rendering and processing handled remotely on GPU servers.
- Simple authentication flow with free trial token and session management.
- Clear instructions for error handling and common workflows.
